newsitem.title: UK: IPE natural gas untraded again, front months softe.
newsitem.headline: IPE natural gas untraded again, front months softe.

text.p: The IPE natural gas futures contract was untraded on Tuesday morning and offers on the front two months were weaker, but other months showed little movement in price direction.
Front month July was offered at 10.100 pence per therm, compared with a settlement price on Monday of 10.165. August was offered at 10.100 pence too but bids were not posted.

Bid/offer spreads on the months from September to December were all two tenths or three tenths of a penny per therm apart, and the bids and offers for these months enclosed the previous day's settlement price.
On Monday, 45 lots were traded, compared with just 70 lots for the entirety of the previous week.
